run_upload_script: run the upload script to upload an .excalidraw file and print a shareable URL
build_upload_excalidraw: build a python script that encrypts an excalidraw diagram with AES-GCM and uploads it to excalidraw.com
test_upload_function: test the upload function by passing excalidraw JSON and verifying it returns a shareable URL
review_concat_buffers: review the concat_buffers function that builds the Excalidraw v2 concat-buffers binary format
refactor_upload_script: refactor the upload script to support custom upload URLs and timeout parameters
